name: Linear Independence Substitution
description: Replaces the search for a graph triangle with the search for a 3-variable subsystem of linear equations that has a unique trivial solution. The coefficient matrix of this subsystem is the adjacency matrix of the 3 vertices, and its determinant is non-zero if and only if all three edges are present. Models that fail to perform this algebraic deduction will attempt to simulate the linear system and TLE.
